change: Assigned Skagerrak and Kattegat as external-transfer regions using ICES Area 27.3.a
rationale: Alignment with established ICES Area definitions to preserve the transition region as an explicit external-transfer unit

change: Adopted ICES Ecoregion Greater North Sea for the study domain
rationale: Provides an authoritative machine-readable marine boundary and resolves the earlier longitude-only proxy

change: Removed a separate GSHHG coastline mask
rationale: The frozen ICES marine polygons define inclusion and a separate coastline product would introduce a second unresolved boundary

change: Implemented a strict 5500 metre coastal tolerance with zero-distance shared boundaries and deterministic tie-breaks
rationale: Includes small coordinate/coastline discrepancies while preserving explicit unknown states outside the tolerance

change: Added collision_index to source-record IDs and UTC timestamps to sample IDs
rationale: Disambiguates repeated provider identifiers and prevents distinct same-day samples from colliding
